title: P1: MCP seed guide shows an invalid plot argument
detail: At bf8fba16e the seed_guide MCP result teaches seed_plot {"plot":"<the contents of plan.json>"} for the worked plot example. Inserting the file contents as a JSON string fails MCP validation with “want an object.” The actual catalog schema expects an object, and the renderer emits the quoted slot at internal/catalog/mention.go:302. An agent following the guide cannot plant the example. Render the parsed JSON as the object value, and exercise the guide's actual example against MCP with isolated state. The reviewer and a fresh verifier independently confirmed the mismatch. See s-2h1k5t.
